title: Ibis of Decay
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a tall, ornate purple ibis-like creature with glowing orange eyes and golden horns. Blue liquid drips from its face and beak onto a cracked, blood-red ground littered with skulls and bones. In the background, a massive cracked orange sphere contains a shadowy robed figure, surrounded by floating skulls and faded text elements like "GRIMOIRE" and "NECROMANCER".
